architectural_notes: Draft deployments can expire if not published; any unsaved product data will be lost and backend product storage may be empty.
known_issues: PDF generation fails when product data is missing/undefined (backend products map empty after draft expiry).

existing_features.title: Add a user-visible action in the Product Editor workspace to recreate the three default products (Digital Planner Mastery, Canva Templates Empire, Printable Wall Art Studio) by resetting local drafts back to the shipped defaults.
Add a confirmation step before resetting drafts to defaults so users do not accidentally wipe their local edits.

Ensure PDF/ZIP generation after restoring defaults uses the restored in-memory product data (not undefined/empty data), and if generation fails, show an error message that is specific and actionable in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Recreate the three digital product entries (Digital Planner Mastery, Canva Templates Empire, Printable Wall Art Studio) that were lost when the unpublished draft expired
Ensure products are persisted/retrievable so PDF generation has valid product data (avoid empty backend products map after draft expiry)
